title: Weakly contractible covers within the affine ind-etale basis
statement: Let $S$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the fixed small pro-etale site and universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Give $S_{\mathrm{app}}=\mathcal B_S$, the full subcategory of affine schemes ind-etale over $S$, its induced coverings [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. Every object $U$ of $S_{\mathrm{app}}$ has a covering family $\{V_j\to U\}$ in $S_{\mathrm{app}}$ such that each $V_j$ is weakly contractible in this same site. Here weakly contractible means that every epimorphism $P\to Q$ of sheaves of sets on $S_{\mathrm{app}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] induces a surjection $P(V_j)\to Q(V_j)$; an epimorphism is a right-cancellable morphism. In particular the covering objects are themselves affine and ind-etale over $S$, not merely objects of the full pro-etale site.

proof.text: Apply exists_isWContractibleRing to A = Γ(U.left, top). The closed source theorem supplies D : Type u, its ring and A-algebra structures, ind-etaleness, faithful flatness and IsWContractibleRing D. No cardinal bound or arbitrary data definition is needed; the existential witness is eliminated inside this theorem proof.

Set p = Spec(algebraMap A D) followed by U.left.isoSpec.inv. The spectrum/ind-etale equivalence and proAffineEtale composition show p and then p followed by U.hom are pro-affine etale. Define V as this basis object and f : V to U with underlying map p. Faithful flatness makes the spectrum map surjective; isomorphism composition preserves surjectivity. The map p is weakly etale and has affine source and target, so Scheme.Hom.singleton_mem_propQCPrecoverage gives its singleton pro-etale covering. The defining comap for basis precoverage and Presieve.map_singleton transfer this to the singleton f, represented by PUnit in Type (u+1).
V.left is literally Spec D, so isWeaklyContractible_of_iso at the identity isomorphism proves that the corresponding full-site object is weakly contractible in section universe u+1.

Restriction R from full-site sheaves to basis-site sheaves is an equivalence E. For a basis-site epimorphism φ : P to Q, put φ′ = E.inverse.map φ; this remains epi. Given s in Q(V), apply the inverse of the evaluated counit at Q to obtain a full-site section. Weak contractibility and Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi supply a preimage q under φ′. The evaluated counit at P sends q to a section over V. Counit naturality gives φ(counit_P(q)) = counit_Q(φ′(q)), which equals s by the chosen lift and the inverse/hom identity. This is the fully proved private helper surjective_evaluation_of_full_site. Apply it to every index of the singleton cover. The construction and transport use no nontriviality; zero rings and empty U obey the same proof.
